description: This file declares an API for monitoring changes to the current working directory, allowing registration of callback functions that are notified upon directory changes, as well as functions for changing directory and reparenting paths.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked when the working directory changes, with an associated name and data.

methods.name: chdir_notify_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered callback, removing it from notifications.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes the working directory to a new path and notifies registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from one root to another, returning a newly allocated string representing the reparented path.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
